# Minimal API Documentation Generator

## Purpose
Generate and maintain documentation for Minimal API endpoints defined in Program.cs.

## Responsibilities
- Analyze endpoint mappings in Program.cs.
- Identify HTTP methods and routes.
- Generate request and response examples.
- Document route parameters, query parameters, and request bodies.
- Keep API documentation synchronized with implementation.

## Guidelines
- Use markdown formatting.
- Include HTTP method and route.
- Include sample request and response payloads.
- Mention validation rules when present.
- Keep documentation concise and developer-friendly.
